# Script-body shapes for the raw configure guard (judge-measured on real scripts, r7 corpus replay).
# Record: a header line `=== allow <id>` or `=== refuse <id>`, then the script body verbatim up to the next header.
# Placeholders (tests/test_raw_configure_files.py _check_parser_body): <cfg> = "<tree>/configure" --x, <tree>, <build>.
# Lines starting with `#` before the first header are comments; inside a record every line is body text.
=== allow helper-shell-c-redirect
inside bash -c 'echo leak > "$1/x"' -- "$A"
=== allow find-lname-glob
find "$pd/fd" -maxdepth 1 -lname "$ROOT/*" -printf '%l\n'
=== allow quoted-program-operand
in_job opencode "touch \"\$HOME/.opencode/.gitignore\""
=== allow helper-shell-c-test
sandboxed "$lane" bash -c 'test ! -S "$HOME/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent" && echo ok'
=== allow trap-program
trap 'printf "%s\t%s\n" "$label" "$(cat "$A/$label.rc" 2>/dev/null)" >> "$A/runs.tsv"' EXIT
=== allow tar-wildcards
tar -x -C "$STAGE" "${tar_excludes[@]}" --wildcards 'opt/rocm/*'
=== allow continued-quoted-operand
run_case 0 "same rev" \
  "${same_rev} bash '${deliverables}' <'${work}/body.md'"
=== allow helper-sh-c-redirect
seen "rewrite" sh -c "echo rewritten > '$state/bin/agentapi'"
=== allow grep-escaped-dot-in-substitution
check "$([ "$(grep -c 'dist/chunk\.js' "$st/err")" -ge 1 ] && echo ok || echo none)" ok "chunk named"
=== allow assignment-substitution-quoted-path
rc=$(run exec -c 'mcp_servers.sneaky.command="/bin/sneaky"' job)
=== allow assignment-substitution-herestring
found=$(grep -q 'internal/forge/github_test\.go' <<< "$out" && echo yes || echo no)
=== allow assignment-substitution-double-star
tracked=$(git ls-files -- "$local_root" "$local_root/**")
=== allow assignment-spaced-url
mksysnum="go run mksysnum.go 'https://example.org/blob_plain/HEAD:/sys/kern/syscalls.master'"
=== allow assignment-substitution-sh-c
rc=$(in_job opencode sh -c "getent hosts example.org > '$A/dns.out' 2>&1; echo \$? >> '$A/dns.out'")
=== allow assignment-apostrophe
quoted="$tmp/it's"
=== allow function-assignments-then-while
f() {
  scan_files=() scan_scanned=0

  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    n=1
  done < x
}
=== allow assignments-then-command
a=() b=0
echo hi
=== refuse quoted-operand-configure
run "<tree>/configure --x"
=== refuse quoted-shell-c-subtoken
run "bash -c '<tree>/configure --x'"
=== refuse helper-shell-c-configure
inside bash -c '<cfg>' -- "$A"
=== refuse helper-sh-c-double-quoted
seen "x" sh -c "cd /tmp && <tree>/configure --x"
=== refuse helper-shell-file-target
sandboxed "$lane" bash inner.sh
=== refuse trap-configure
trap '<cfg>' EXIT
=== refuse trap-double-dash-configure
trap -- '<cfg>' INT TERM
=== refuse later-operand-configure
foo <tree>/configure
=== refuse later-operand-letter-glob
foo <tree>/conf*
=== refuse shell-glob-operand
bash <tree>/conf*
=== refuse array-assignment-configure
cmd=(<tree>/configure --x)
=== refuse assignment-configure
x=<tree>/configure
=== refuse assignment-dynamic-configure
x="$SRC/configure"
=== refuse assignment-spaced-configure
x="cd /tmp && <tree>/configure --x"
=== refuse assignments-then-configure
x=() y=0
<cfg>
=== refuse function-assignments-then-if-bare
f() {
  a=() b=0
  if true; then configure --x; fi
}
=== refuse function-assignments-then-while-configure
f() {
  a=() b=0

  while true; do
    <cfg>
  done
}
=== refuse function-assignments-then-for-bare
f() {
  a=() b=0
  for i in 1; do configure --x; done
}
=== refuse function-assignments-then-until
f() {
  a=() b=0
  until false; do <cfg>; done
}
=== refuse substitution-in-assignment
rc=$(<cfg>)
=== refuse substitution-in-helper-operand
check "$(<cfg>)" ok
